description:
Dozens of Unitree humanoid robots just achieved a world first with a fully autonomous martial arts swarm performance in Beijing. The G1 and H2 robots moved in perfect sync, breaking new ground in artificial intelligence powered robotics.

In this video, we take a closer look at the Unitree G1 humanoid robot swarm performing rapid martial arts choreography, advanced balance recovery, and synchronized formations. The H2 robot appears in Monkey King armor, riding the B2W quadruped robot dog in a dramatic cultural presentation. This event showcases cutting edge humanoid robotics, multi robot coordination, reinforcement learning, motion planning, and real time artificial intelligence control systems. From high speed kicks to stable group movement, this performance signals a major step forward in humanoid robot autonomy and swarm intelligence.
